title: festuca ovina var. major
intro: Festuca ovina var. major, commonly known as sheep's fescue, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Festuca ovina var. major are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
